notes.title: Introducing Playground & Time Trials
notes.notes:
Version: 1.1.0 of Fizik introduces the new playground mode which is an open environment that lets players practice their skills in a stress-free environment. They can spend as much time as they want in this mode!

Additionally, there is a time trials mode which is the largest speedrunning map we have created so far and it is about completing the level as fast as possible. This new mode has several different routes to complete it. This is the most intense map ever been created for Fizik and it will be a test for all of the pro Fizik players out there to prove their worth!

Finally, there are a few bug fixes to the game. The first is removing the bug which changed the players speed depending on the power and resolution of their computer and death collisions sometimes not working on some levels. We have also made several UI improvements such as clear UI which communicates when the player unlocks a special level, how many orbs a special level requires to unlock, new data on how close a player is to unlocking an achievement, and more. We have also added new Steam achievements to add an extra incentive to keep playing.

That's all for this update, we hope you enjoy :D
